ideas.title: Trump Administration's Use of Federal Funding as a Tool for Coercion
ideas.description: An investigation into the Trump administration's use of federal funding to exert control over states and municipalities.
ideas.angle: The use of federal funding as a means of coercion and punishment
questions: What are the specific programs and funding mechanisms being used?
How are states and municipalities responding to the funding freeze?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of abuse of power and corruption within the Trump administration.

ideas.title: Impact of Program Terminations on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: An investigation into the impact of the Trump administration's program terminations on vulnerable populations, including rural families and communities of color.
ideas.angle: The effects of program terminations on marginalized communities
questions: What are the specific programs being terminated?
How are vulnerable populations being affected?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe this story has the potential to highlight the human cost of the Trump administration's policy decisions.
